intent: Repair the live snapshot-PR cleanup without broadening deletion authority: require same-repository ownership, an exact timestamped ops/spine-adoption-pr-lifecycle branch, and an independently anchored report(governance): ops run title for that lane. Preserve closed snapshot branch refs for recovery. Keep legacy snapshot matchers unchanged outside this new branch-specific rule.

commit.message: fix(governance): bind snapshot cleanup to exact intent

interface_mismatches: The cleanup policy declared lifecycle/spine-adoption status snapshots non-mergeable, but the matcher omitted the live ops/spine-adoption-pr-lifecycle timestamp grammar.
The first repair reused broad legacy intent ORs for the new branch grammar, so a human title containing ops report could falsely authorize closure.
Pass 1 deleted snapshot branch refs immediately even though the recovery claim relied on closed PR history.
honest_blockers: Decorrelated council rounds one and two held earlier heads on false-positive title authority and provider-schema failures. The final consolidated head requires a fresh full council and current-head GitHub checks before merge.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the bounded PR. Snapshot PRs remain in closed history and their branch refs are preserved, so a mistaken closure can be reopened without reconstructing the head.
